issues.display_title: Issue #1762: Use Stripe charge id as transid for upgrade flow
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Stripe subscription upgrade still stores the subscription id (sub_...) as transid in cc_logs / cc_purchase / invoice email data.

This happens in both upgrade paths:

  • Non-3DS: app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Stripe/Subscription/Upgrade.php
    • processUpgradeSuccess() calls insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade(transactionId: $updatedSubscription->id, ...)
  • 3DS: app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Stripe/Subscription/CompleteUpgrade3DS.php
    • handle() calls insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade(transactionId: $updatedSubscription->id, ...)

Reference

Use the normal subscription flow as reference:

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/SubscriptionHelpers.php
    • handlePaymentSuccess() resolves $chargeId = ChargeIdResolver::resolve($subscribe, $oneTimePayment)
    • generateAndSaveInvoice() uses $transId = $chargeId ?? $subsId
    • sendSubscriptionSuccessEmail() uses $transactionId = $chargeId ?? $subscribe->id

So recurring subscription still saves the Stripe subscription id in user recurring profile, but payment transaction records prefer Stripe charge id (ch_...) when available.

Expected

Upgrade flow should keep sub_... only as the recurring subscription/profile id, but use the actual Stripe charge id (ch_...) as transid when writing payment transaction artifacts:

  • cc_logs.transid
  • cc_purchase.transid
  • generated invoice lookup/id
  • upgrade success email subs_transaction_id

Fallback to sub_... only when no charge id can be resolved.

Suggested minimal fix

  • Retrieve/expand latest invoice with payment_intent.latest_charge in both upgrade completion paths.
  • Resolve charge id from the updated subscription or latest invoice, matching subscription flow behavior.
  • Pass resolved charge id into UpgradeHelper::insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade() and sendUpgradeSuccessEmail().
  • Keep user subscription update using $updatedSubscription->id.

Acceptance criteria

  • Stripe upgrade without 3DS saves ch_... as transid when Stripe provides a charge.
  • Stripe upgrade with 3DS saves ch_... as transid when Stripe provides a charge.
  • Existing invoice generation can find the new upgrade purchase by that transaction id.
  • If charge id is unavailable, existing sub_... fallback still works.

Result

  • Both upgrade paths (Upgrade.php non-3DS, CompleteUpgrade3DS.php) now resolve the Stripe charge id via latest_invoice.payment_intent.latest_charge.id and pass it through UpgradeHelper.
  • Charge id (ch_...) used for cc_logs/cc_purchase/invoice lookup/success email; falls back to subscription id (sub_...) when Stripe has no charge.
  • PR: #1765 (merged), tests: UpgradeHelperTest, ChargeIdResolverTest, InvoiceIdResolverTest.

issues.display_title: Issue #1763: Use Stripe charge ID for space addon cc_purchase transid
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Stripe space-addon purchases currently write the Stripe subscription id (sub_...) into cc_purchase.transid.

Current flow:

  • Route: POST /v2/payment/subscription/space-addon
  • SpaceAddon::executeSpaceAddonChangePlan() calls UpgradeHelper::insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade(transactionId: $charged->id, ...)
  • $charged->id is the updated Stripe subscription id
  • PaymentHelpers::insertTransaction() writes transaction_id into cc_purchase.transid

Relevant files:

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Stripe/Subscription/SpaceAddon.php
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/UpgradeHelper.php
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/PaymentHelpers.php

Expected

For space-addon successful card payments, cc_purchase.transid should use the Stripe charge id (ch_...) like normal subscription purchase records, not the subscription id (sub_...).

Suggested minimal fix

After retrieving the paid latest invoice, resolve the related Stripe charge id from the invoice/payment intent and pass that id into insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade().

Keep the Stripe subscription id available where needed for subscription/profile fields, but do not use it as cc_purchase.transid for the purchase row.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Space-addon success inserts cc_purchase.transid as ch_....
  • cc_logs.transid and generated invoice lookup still use the same purchase transaction id.
  • Existing upgrade/subscription behavior is not changed unless it has the same bug intentionally fixed.
  • Add the smallest runnable check or test around charge-id resolution if practical.

Result

  • Added ChargeIdResolver to resolve the Stripe charge id (ch_...) from the paid latest invoice for space-addon purchases.
  • SpaceAddon::executeSpaceAddonChangePlan() now passes the resolved charge id into insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade(); falls back to the subscription id (sub_...) if no charge is found.
  • PR: #1767 (merged), tests: SpaceAddonTransactionIdTest, ChargeIdResolverTest.

issues.display_title: Issue #1764: Record Stripe recurring transactions cronjob
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add a cronjob endpoint that records Stripe recurring subscription renewal charges into legacy billing tables.

Current state

Stripe recurring renewal charges happen outside the synchronous subscribe flow, but they were not being logged into cc_logs_stripe or inserted into cc_purchase. That leaves renewal revenue missing from the legacy transaction/reporting tables.

Target state

  • Pull Stripe charges for the cronjob window and filter to subscription renewal cycles.
  • Log every Stripe recurring charge attempt to cc_logs_stripe.
  • Insert a deduped cc_purchase row for successful recurring charges when a user can be resolved.
  • Resolve user_id from user_extra_data.recurring_profile / recurring_profile_photo_studio as the DB fallback tier.
  • Resolve product_id from Stripe price metadata.
  • Dedup purchase inserts by Stripe invoice_id.
  • Support ?test_mode=1 for Stripe test-mode manual verification.

Scope

  • routes/cronjobRoutes.php — add the cronjob route.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Cronjobs/CronjobController.php — wire the endpoint.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Cronjobs/Helpers/RecordStripeRecurringTransactionsHelper.php — orchestrate charge fetch, filtering, logging, user/product resolution, and purchase insert.
  • app/Http/Controllers/Cronjobs/Helpers/StripeRecurringChargeRules.php — isolate recurring-cycle and purchase-recording decision rules.
  • app/Class/CCLogClass.php — make Stripe log writes retry-safe via upsert on transid.
  • api-collection/GoThru API NEW/Cronjob/Record Stripe Recurring Transactions.yml — add Bruno/manual API entry.
  • tests/Helpers/Cronjobs/StripeRecurringChargeRulesTest.php — cover the pure decision rules.

Out of scope

  • Backfilling historical recurring charges.
  • Using subscription.metadata.user_id as the primary user resolution tier.
  • Changing existing synchronous subscribe, upgrade, downgrade, PayPal, or non-subscription purchase flows.

Risk / test plan

  • Run unit coverage for the recurring charge decision rules.
  • Run php -l on changed PHP files.
  • Manually verify against Stripe test mode with real DB/test credentials: first run inserts logs/purchases, second run dedups cleanly, and failures are counted/logged instead of silently swallowed.

Result

Implemented in PR #1760.

Tests already reported in the PR:

  • ./vendor/bin/phpunit tests/Helpers/Cronjobs/StripeRecurringChargeRulesTest.php — passing.
  • php -l clean on changed PHP files.
  • Manual Stripe test-mode verification completed after the final schema correction: inserts cleanly end-to-end, second run confirms dedup.

issues.display_title: Issue #1766: Use PayPal capture id as transid for upgrade flow
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

PayPal subscription upgrade still stores the new PayPal subscription id (I-...) as transid in payment artifacts.

Current upgrade path:

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/UpgradeHandler.php
    • postUpdateBestEffort() calls insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade(transactionId: $newSubscription['id'] ?? '', ...)
    • upgrade success email uses subs_transaction_id => $newSubscription['id'] ?? ''

That means cc_logs.transid, cc_purchase.transid, invoice lookup, and email transaction id use the subscription id instead of the actual PayPal capture/transaction id.

Reference

Use PayPal subscription flow as reference:

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Paypal/Subscription/Subscription/Capture/Actions/SubscribeHandler.php
    • recurring path calls getSubscriptionTransactions($transactionId, $isTestMode)
    • stores latest transaction id as $captureId
    • builds subscribe object with id => $transactionId and capture_id => $captureId
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/Subscription/PaypalTransIdResolver.php
    • returns $subscribe->capture_id ?? $subscribe->id ?? null

So user recurring profile should still use the PayPal subscription id (I-...), but payment transaction records should prefer the PayPal capture/transaction id when available.

Expected

PayPal upgrade should keep I-... only as the recurring subscription/profile id, but use the latest PayPal capture/transaction id as transid when writing payment artifacts:

  • cc_logs.transid
  • cc_purchase.transid
  • generated invoice lookup/id
  • upgrade success email subs_transaction_id

Fallback to I-... only when no PayPal transaction id can be resolved.

Suggested minimal fix

  • In PayPal upgrade postUpdateBestEffort(), resolve the latest PayPal subscription transaction id for $newSubscription['id'].
  • Reuse PaypalTransIdResolver semantics if possible: prefer capture/transaction id, fallback to subscription id.
  • Pass the resolved id to insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade() and the upgrade success email.
  • Keep updateUserDataForUpgrade() / Photo Studio user update using the new subscription id.

Acceptance criteria

  • PayPal upgrade saves latest PayPal capture/transaction id as transid when available.
  • PayPal upgrade success email uses the same resolved transaction id.
  • Existing recurring profile remains the PayPal subscription id (I-...).
  • If PayPal transaction lookup fails or returns no id, existing I-... fallback still works.

Related Stripe fix: #1765

Result

  • Resolved PayPal capture/transaction id (reusing PaypalTransIdResolver semantics) inside UpgradeHandler::postUpdateBestEffort(), with retry added to the shared transaction fetcher.
  • Resolved id passed to insertCCPurchaseForUpgrade() and upgrade success email; I-... subscription id kept as fallback and still used for the recurring profile.
  • PR: #1768 (merged), tests: UpgradeHandlerTransIdTest, PaypalTransIdResolverTest.

issues.display_title: Issue #1769: Backfill metadata.user_id on pre-existing Stripe subscriptions
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Stripe subscriptions created before the Subscription.php change (now on main) that sets metadata.user_id at create time are missing this metadata. Existing subscriptions referenced by user_extra_data.recurring_profile / recurring_profile_photo_studio need a one-off backfill.

Task

  • Add php artisan payment:backfill-subscription-metadata {--dry-run} command that sets metadata.user_id on every pre-existing Stripe subscription.
  • Skip non-Stripe ids (column also holds PayPal subscription ids).
  • Route each user through the existing live/test Stripe client selection.
  • Skip-and-continue on per-subscription errors so one bad id doesn't abort the run.

Resolution

Fixed in #1761.

Result

  • Added BackfillSubscriptionMetadataAction + payment:backfill-subscription-metadata {--dry-run} command; iterates recurring_profile/recurring_profile_photo_studio, sets metadata.user_id on each Stripe subscription.
  • Non-Stripe (PayPal) ids skipped, live/test Stripe client picked per user, per-subscription errors skip-and-continue.
  • PR: #1761 (merged), tests: BackfillSubscriptionMetadataActionTest (6/6), BackfillSubscriptionMetadataTest (2/2). Manual --dry-run against production still pending (no Stripe creds in dev env).
